label: Swaps: tilapia + basil, 100 m2, Netherlands glasshouse: architecture, heating and part swaps side by side
_how_to_edit: Each option is a patch on the base build (dicts merge, lists and values replace). Part alternatives from the catalog are added automatically (include_component_alternatives).

base._location: Wage and electricity come from data/scenarios/unit_configuration_candidates_v0.json (locations block).
base._structure_area_basis: planning_area_m2_uvi_ratio (grow area x UVI land ratio) or minimum_area_m2 (grow area + equipment footprint).

options.label: Media bed with expanded clay instead of DWC raft
options.note: Fish and feed drop to 25% of the raft rate (SRAC 454 factor, low confidence). No sourced media-bed basil yield, so cost per kg is n/a; bed container not priced.
options.confidence_reason: Feed and fish fall to 25% of the raft rate on one SRAC sentence (low confidence); no sourced media-bed basil yield; clay lifetime and bed container not sourced.
options.risk: Beds clog with solids and need labour-intensive washing (FAO 589); the media doubles as solids filter and biofilter in small systems.
options.labour: Washing clogged media; no raft handling.

options.label: NFT with uPVC channels instead of DWC raft
options.note: Yield = DWC yield x 0.83-0.95 (Blunk 2023, Pasch 2021; candidate). Channel metres per m2 not sourced, so channel cost is a gap. No NL biofilter media price, so the separate biofilter NFT needs is a gap too.
options.confidence_reason: NFT yield is 0.83-0.95 of raft from two studies that disagree on size (pending Batch 003); fish feed at 25% of the raft rate is a low-confidence rule; channels and biofilter not fully priced.
options.risk: Most sensitive to pump stops: a thin film dries out within hours, while a raft holds water. Needs fine solids removal and a separate biofilter.
options.labour: Channels need flushing and root clearing after each crop.

options.label: Air-water heat pump instead of gas boiler (same heat demand)
options.note: Heat pump lifetime is not sourced, so its build cost per year is left out. Gas boiler price is also missing in the base.
options.confidence_reason: COP 3.7-4.6 and gas-to-heat conversion are corroborated Tier 2 values (pending Batch 003), but heat demand is transferred from sweet pepper and the heat pump lifetime is not sourced.
options.risk: Needs a low-temperature (35-45 C) heating system; cost depends on the gas-to-power price ratio.
options.labour: Service contract and refrigerant checks (frequency not sourced).

options.label: Unheated glasshouse (heating off)
options.note: Upper bound on what heating costs. Yield stays at the heated value, which an unheated NL house would not reach in winter (not modelled).
options.confidence_reason: The model keeps the heated yield, but an unheated Dutch glasshouse would not grow basil through winter (not modelled), so this is an upper bound on the heating cost, not a real option.
options.risk: Basil stops growing or dies in cold months.

options.label: Existing building instead of a new glasshouse
options.note: Heating off too: heat demand is per m2 of greenhouse. A building would need lights, which are not in the catalog.
options.confidence_reason: Rent, lighting and building climate are not in the catalog, so the saving is overstated.
options.risk: A closed building needs grow lights (not priced).
